title: Hydraulic fluid power - Fluid sample containers - Qualifying and controlling cleaning methods
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13569) covers Hydraulic fluid power - Fluid sample containers - Qualifying and controlling cleaning methods. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 3722 : 1976 'Hydraulic fluid power — Fluid sample containers — Qualifying and controlling cleaning methods', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the recommendations of the Hydraulic Fluid Fewer Systems Sectional Committee ( PF. 15 ) and approval of the Production Engineering Division Council. The text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviation. Certain conventions are however not identical with these used in the Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker in the Internaticnol Standard while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker.
